block.projecte.advanced_alchemical_chest: The colour has been set to %s.
You must be holding a %s to set the colour.
Just like the alchemical bag, but in a chest form. Shift click with a bag to set the colour.
codex.projecte.entry.dark_matter.text: The first matter, dense enough to swallow light. Tools, armour, rings and machines start here. Four make a block.
codex.projecte.entry.dm_armor.text: Armour that never breaks. A full set stops 80% of the damage you take and shrugs off explosions. The boots end fall damage, the helmet lets you breathe under water.
codex.projecte.entry.emc_links.text:
A link between your EMC and pipes. What is piped in becomes EMC and is learnt.

Use it with an item to set what it hands out, and pipes can draw that from it. Use it empty handed to buy a stack yourself, with an empty bucket to buy fluid, and sneak to clear it. Each tier moves more.
codex.projecte.entry.gem_armor.text:
The strongest armour there is.

The helmet heals, sees in the dark (Shift+X) and walks on water. The chestplate feeds you and keeps fire and lava off. The leggings drop you fast while sneaking and push mobs away. The boots end fall damage, jump higher and step up blocks (X).

Its offensive gifts only work if the server allows offensiveAbilities.
codex.projecte.entry.klein_stars.text:
Stars that hold EMC. Tools and rings draw from any star you carry, and a Transmutation Table can fill them.

Ein holds 50,000, Zwei 200,000, Drei 800,000, Vier 3.2 million, Sphere 12.8 million, Omega 51.2 million.

The first four are made in the Athanor. The star you upgrade goes in the centre and keeps what it holds, and every one of these rituals ends under open sky. Sphere and Omega need the Grand Athanor and the hearts of the great beasts.

A star made in the Athanor can not be learnt.
codex.projecte.entry.knowledge.text:
To make a thing you must first understand it. Burn an item in a Transmutation Table and you learn it: from then on you can take it out again whenever you can pay its worth.

Cheap things are understood at a glance. Anything worth more than 2,048 has to be studied first: burn four of it, and only then do you know it. Locking an item in the table teaches nothing you do not already understand.

Your EMC and your knowledge belong to you, not to the table. Every table and tablet you touch shares them.

Some things can only be made, never learnt. The Athanor guards those.
codex.projecte.entry.matter_tiers.text:
Between the black of Nigredo and the white of Albedo the old alchemists saw the peacock's tail, every colour at once. The coloured matters are that stage.

After Red come Magenta, Pink, Purple, Violet, Blue, Cyan, Green, Lime, Yellow, Orange, White and Fading. The Final Star Shard stands above them all.

Magenta to Orange are made in the Athanor, three of the matter before on the dais and a catalyst from the world in the centre: Chorus Fruit, Pink Petals, a Shulker Shell, an Amethyst Cluster, a Heart of the Sea, an Echo Shard, a Turtle Scute, a Sculk Catalyst, a Breeze Rod, Magma Cream. Each ritual costs what six fuels of the tier before were worth.

White Matter, the end of the peacock's tail, needs the Grand Athanor. Fading is still three matter between six fuel. Matter from the Athanor, and its blocks, can not be learnt.
codex.projecte.entry.ouroboros.text:
Gem armour bound in the Grand Athanor with the hearts of the great beasts. Every piece keeps all the powers of the Gem piece it was, and adds one:

The Crown, with the Elder Eye: darkness and weariness do not touch you, and nothing hostile can hide. The Mantle, with the Warden's Heart: what strikes you may be answered with a sonic boom. The Greaves, with the Blighted Soul: the wither does not touch you, and your blows heal you. The Treads, with the Dragon Heart: arrows pass through you.

All four: a ritual you lead holds together instead of rebounding.
The true stone. It can not be crafted: three false stones and a Nether Star are fused into it in the Athanor.

Use it on a block to transmute it, sneak to get the other result. G sets the shape, V the size.

C opens a crafting grid. In crafting it converts: coal into Alchemical Coal, iron into gold, gold into diamonds, and back. The stone stays in the grid.

R throws a Mob Randomiser.
codex.projecte.entry.red_matter.text: Dark Matter refined with the true stone. Faster tools, stronger armour, better machines. Four make a block.
command.projecte.knowledge.invalid: The item "%1$s" does not  have an EMC value, and cannot be learnt.
If a tooltip should be shown on items which can be learnt, denoting if the item has been learnt or not. Note: ProjectE's client.shift_emc applies to this.
configuration.projecte.client.tooltips.l: Requires holding shift to display the learnt/unlearnt text as a tooltip on items and blocks. Note: this does nothing if EMC Tooltips are disabled.
configuration.projecte.common.crafting.f: Require full omega klein stars in the tome of knowledge and gem armour recipes. This is the same behavior that EE2 had.
configuration.projecte.processing.data_c: Calculates EMC value of trimmed armour.
configuration.projecte.server.comprehens: How many of a more valuable item have to be burned before it is learnt.
If false, every item is learnt on the first burn, as in ProjectE.
Items worth up to this much EMC are learnt on the first burn. A diamond is worth 8,192, an iron ingot 256.
Valuable items have to be burned several times before they are learnt.
configuration.projecte.server.difficulty: Set to false to disable Gem Armour offensive abilities (helmet zap and chestplate explosion).
configuration.projecte.server.misc.unsaf: False requires your hand be empty for Gem Armour Offensive Abilities to be readied or triggered.
